function jumpToSlide(c, idx, smooth?): void

Defined in: website/components/carousel/custom-carousel/nav.ts:228

Instant (default) or smooth position jump to slide idx — used for the clone teleports and resize refits. When layout hasn't produced measurable widths yet (display:none parent, pre-paint) it retries one frame later rather than computing a bogus 0-offset jump.
